## Methods

```{r}
run_all_methods <- function(x, tail = "upper", thr_iso = 0.6, yj_type = "bestObj") {
  shash <- function(method_init) {
    rrobot::SHASH_out(x, thr0 = 2.58, thr1 = 3, thr = 3, tail = tail,
                      method_init = method_init, thr_iso = thr_iso, maxit = 100)
  }
  list(YJ      = cellWise::transfo(x, type = yj_type, robust = TRUE, standardize = TRUE),
       SHASH.i = shash("isoplus"),
       SHASH.z = shash("emprule"))
}

flag_by_tail <- function(z, tail, thr = 3) {
  if (tail == "upper") which(z > thr) else if (tail == "lower") which(z < -thr) else which(abs(z) > thr)
}

# outlier thresholds on the original scale; sigma and tau are on the log scale
shash_cutoff <- function(fit, q) {
  cf <- fit$SHASH_coef
  as.numeric(rrobot::normal_to_SHASH(q, cf$mu, cf$sigma, cf$nu, cf$tau))
}
yj_cutoff <- function(yj, q) {
  tryCatch(as.numeric(cellWise::transfo_transformback(q, yj)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}
```

## Plot helpers

```{r}
cols_detected <- c("Not Outlier" = "#1B4F72", "Detected Outlier" = "#E67E22")
cols_true     <- c("Not Outlier" = "#1B4F72", "True Outlier"     = "#E67E22")

sizes_default <- list(base = 10, title = 10, axis_title = 9, axis_text = 8, annot = 3,
                      axis_titles = TRUE, label_top = FALSE)
sizes_big     <- list(base = 9, title = 9.5, axis_title = 8.5, axis_text = 7.5, annot = 2.7,
                      axis_titles = FALSE, label_top = TRUE)

topgear_row_w <- 8
topgear_row_h <- 2.3

theme_toy <- function(sizes) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = sizes$base) +
    theme(
      plot.title          = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = sizes$title),
      legend.position     = "none",
      panel.grid.major    = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
      axis.title          = if (isTRUE(sizes$axis_titles)) element_text(size = sizes$axis_title)
                            else element_blank(),
      axis.text           = element_text(size = sizes$axis_text),
      axis.ticks.x        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.length.x = unit(-7, "pt")
    )
}

norm_overlay <- function(n, binwidth) {
  d <- data.frame(x = seq(-7, 7, length.out = 400))
  d$y <- dnorm(d$x) * n * binwidth
  d
}
```

Transformed values coloured by each method's flags (Top Gear). Values are truncated at ±7, and the threshold on the original scale is printed next to each threshold line.

```{r}
build_plot_detected <- function(values, out_idx, title, threshold_label = NULL,
                                lower_threshold_label = NULL, y_annot = NULL,
                                tail = "both", sizes = sizes_default) {
  keep  <- which(!is.na(values))
  det   <- seq_along(values) %in% out_idx
  vals  <- pmin(pmax(values[keep], -7), 7)
  label <- factor(ifelse(det[keep], "Detected Outlier", "Not Outlier"),
                  levels = c("Not Outlier", "Detected Outlier"))
  y_annot <- if (is.null(y_annot)) max(hist(vals, breaks = 40, plot = FALSE)$counts) * 0.95 else y_annot

  # labels either run up from y_annot, or hang down from the top of the panel
  lab_y     <- if (isTRUE(sizes$label_top)) Inf else y_annot
  lab_hjust <- if (isTRUE(sizes$label_top)) 1.05 else 0

  binwidth <- 0.35
  vlines   <- if (tail == "upper") 3 else if (tail == "lower") -3 else c(-3, 3)

  p <- ggplot(data.frame(value = vals, label = label), aes(x = value, fill = label)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", binwidth = binwidth) +
    geom_line(data = norm_overlay(length(vals), binwidth), aes(x = x, y = y),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted", color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_detected, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Transformed Values", y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
    theme_toy(sizes) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-7, 7))

  add_label <- function(p, x, lab) {
    p + annotate("text", x = x, y = lab_y,
                 label = prettyNum(lab, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
                 angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, hjust = lab_hjust, size = sizes$annot, color = "darkred")
  }
  if (!is.null(threshold_label)) p <- add_label(p, 3, threshold_label)
  if (!is.null(lower_threshold_label) && tail != "upper") p <- add_label(p, -3, lower_threshold_label)
  p
}
```

Transformed values coloured by the known outliers (HBK, Wood). Values beyond ±7 are drawn at ±7 and coloured as outliers. The N(0, 1) curve is scaled to the number of inliers.

```{r}
build_plot_true <- function(values, true_out_idx, title) {
  keep <- which(!is.na(values))
  vals <- pmin(pmax(values[keep], -7), 7)
  tag  <- rep("Not Outlier", length(vals))
  tag[keep %in% true_out_idx] <- "True Outlier"
  tag[vals <= -7 | vals >= 7] <- "True Outlier"

  binwidth <- 0.35

  ggplot(tibble(value = vals, label = factor(tag, levels = c("Not Outlier", "True Outlier"))),
         aes(x = value, fill = label)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", binwidth = binwidth) +
    geom_line(data = norm_overlay(sum(tag == "Not Outlier"), binwidth), aes(x = x, y = y),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dotted", color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_true) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Transformed Values", y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
    theme_toy(sizes_default) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-7, 7))
}

build_plot_original <- function(x, title, true_out_idx = NULL, sizes = sizes_default) {
  if (!is.null(true_out_idx)) {
    fill_var <- if_else(seq_along(x) %in% true_out_idx, "True Outlier", "Not Outlier")
    cols_use <- cols_true
  } else {
    fill_var <- rep("Not Outlier", length(x))
    cols_use <- c("Not Outlier" = "#1B4F72")
  }
  ggplot(data.frame(x = x, fill_var = fill_var), aes(x = x, fill = fill_var)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_use) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Value", y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
    theme_toy(sizes)
}

save_row_plot <- function(plots, filepath, width = 11, height = 3) {
  ggsave(filename = filepath, plot = plot_grid(plotlist = plots, nrow = 1),
         width = width, height = height)
}
```

Legend for Figure 8 (Not Outlier / Detected Outlier).

```{r}
save_status_legend <- function(file, labels = names(cols_detected), cols = unname(cols_detected)) {
  W <- 1740; H <- 268   # pixels at 300 dpi
  keys <- data.frame(xmin = c(81, 795), xmax = c(213, 927), ymin = 90, ymax = 222,
                     fill = cols, label = labels, x_txt = c(272, 985))

  p <- ggplot(keys) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill)) +
    geom_text(aes(x = x_txt, y = 156, label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 6.8) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, W), ylim = c(0, H), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

  ggsave(file, p, width = W / 300, height = H / 300, dpi = 300)
}

save_status_legend(file.path(toy_dir, "status_legend_1X2.png"))
```

## Figure 8: Top Gear

Weight is checked in both tails, MPG and Price in the upper tail.
log(MPG) and log(Price) are fitted on the log scale, and their thresholds are converted back to MPG and pounds.
`y_annot` is the height of the threshold labels.

```{r}
topgear_vars <- list(
  MPG      = list(x = TopGear$MPG,        label = "MPG",        tail = "upper", log = FALSE, round_thr = FALSE, y_annot = 39),
  Weight   = list(x = TopGear$Weight,     label = "Weight",     tail = "both",  log = FALSE, round_thr = TRUE,  y_annot = 29),
  Price    = list(x = TopGear$Price,      label = "Price",      tail = "upper", log = FALSE, round_thr = TRUE,  y_annot = 19),
  logMPG   = list(x = log(TopGear$MPG),   label = "log(MPG)",   tail = "upper", log = TRUE,  round_thr = FALSE, y_annot = 39),
  logPrice = list(x = log(TopGear$Price), label = "log(Price)", tail = "upper", log = TRUE,  round_thr = TRUE,  y_annot = 19)
)

fmt_thr <- function(x, round_thr) if (is.na(x)) NULL else if (round_thr) round(x, 0) else round(x, 1)

topgear_results <- list()

for (var_name in names(topgear_vars)) {
  cfg <- topgear_vars[[var_name]]
  res <- run_all_methods(cfg$x, tail = cfg$tail, yj_type = "bestObj")
  topgear_results[[var_name]] <- res

  back  <- if (cfg$log) exp else identity
  lower <- cfg$tail == "both"
  thr <- list(
    yj = c(back(yj_cutoff(res$YJ, 3)),         if (lower) back(yj_cutoff(res$YJ, -3)) else NA),
    z  = c(back(shash_cutoff(res$SHASH.z, 3)), if (lower) back(shash_cutoff(res$SHASH.z, -3)) else NA),
    i  = c(back(shash_cutoff(res$SHASH.i, 3)), if (lower) back(shash_cutoff(res$SHASH.i, -3)) else NA)
  )
  cat(cfg$label, "thresholds (upper, lower) | RewML:", round(thr$yj, 2),
      "| SHASH-z:", round(thr$z, 2), "| SHASH-i:", round(thr$i, 2), "\n")

  yj_z <- as.numeric(res$YJ$Y[, 1])
  panel <- function(values, out_idx, title, t) {
    build_plot_detected(values, out_idx, title,
                        threshold_label       = fmt_thr(t[1], cfg$round_thr),
                        lower_threshold_label = fmt_thr(t[2], cfg$round_thr),
                        y_annot = cfg$y_annot, tail = cfg$tail, sizes = sizes_big)
  }

  save_row_plot(
    list(build_plot_original(cfg$x, title = cfg$label, sizes = sizes_big),
         panel(yj_z, flag_by_tail(yj_z, cfg$tail), "RewML Box-Cox/YJ", thr$yj),
         panel(res$SHASH.z$x_norm, res$SHASH.z$out_idx, "SHASH-z", thr$z),
         panel(res$SHASH.i$x_norm, res$SHASH.i$out_idx, "SHASH-i", thr$i)),
    filepath = file.path(toy_dir, "TopGear", paste0("TopGear-", var_name, ".png")),
    width = topgear_row_w, height = topgear_row_h
  )
}
```

## Figure 9: HBK

All four variables are checked in the upper tail. Observations 1–14 are outliers in X1–X3, and 1–10 in Y.

```{r}
hbk_vars <- list(
  X1 = list(x = hbk$X1, true_out = 1:14),
  X2 = list(x = hbk$X2, true_out = 1:14),
  X3 = list(x = hbk$X3, true_out = 1:14),
  Y  = list(x = hbk$Y,  true_out = 1:10)
)

hbk_results <- list()

for (var_name in names(hbk_vars)) {
  cfg <- hbk_vars[[var_name]]
  res <- run_all_methods(cfg$x, tail = "upper", yj_type = "YJ")
  hbk_results[[var_name]] <- res

  cat(var_name, "upper thresholds | RewML:", round(yj_cutoff(res$YJ, 3), 2),
      "| SHASH-z:", round(shash_cutoff(res$SHASH.z, 3), 2),
      "| SHASH-i:", round(shash_cutoff(res$SHASH.i, 3), 2), "\n")

  save_row_plot(
    list(build_plot_original(cfg$x, title = var_name, true_out_idx = cfg$true_out),
         build_plot_true(as.numeric(res$YJ$Y[, 1]), cfg$true_out, "RewML Box-Cox/YJ"),
         build_plot_true(res$SHASH.z$x_norm, cfg$true_out, "SHASH-z"),
         build_plot_true(res$SHASH.i$x_norm, cfg$true_out, "SHASH-i")),
    filepath = file.path(toy_dir, "HBK", paste0("HBK-", var_name, ".png"))
  )
}
```

## Figure 10 and Figure S.14: Wood

Observations 4, 6, 8 and 19 are outliers. The methods are applied to the first robust principal component, checked in the upper tail.

```{r}
true_out_wood <- c(4, 6, 8, 19)

png(file.path(toy_dir, "Wood", "Scatterplot-Matrix-Wood.png"), width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 500)
par(las = 2)
pairs(wood[, 1:5],
      pch = 19, col = ifelse(seq_len(nrow(wood)) %in% true_out_wood, "#E67E22", "#1B4F72"),
      cex = 1.4, gap = 0.5, oma = c(3, 3, 3, 3), cex.labels = 1.8, font.labels = 2,
      upper.panel = NULL)
dev.off()

pca_wood <- rrcov::PcaHubert(wood[, 1:5], k = 5, scale = TRUE, signflip = TRUE)
wood_pc1 <- as.data.frame(pca_wood@scores)$PC1

res_wood <- run_all_methods(wood_pc1, tail = "upper", yj_type = "YJ")

cat("Wood PC1 upper thresholds | RewML:", round(yj_cutoff(res_wood$YJ, 3), 2),
    "| SHASH-z:", round(shash_cutoff(res_wood$SHASH.z, 3), 2),
    "| SHASH-i:", round(shash_cutoff(res_wood$SHASH.i, 3), 2), "\n")

save_row_plot(
  list(build_plot_original(wood_pc1, title = "PC1", true_out_idx = true_out_wood),
       build_plot_true(as.numeric(res_wood$YJ$Y[, 1]), true_out_wood, "RewML Box-Cox/YJ"),
       build_plot_true(res_wood$SHASH.z$x_norm, true_out_wood, "SHASH-z"),
       build_plot_true(res_wood$SHASH.i$x_norm, true_out_wood, "SHASH-i")),
  filepath = file.path(toy_dir, "Wood", "WoodPC1-TrueOutliers.png")
)
```


Flags per method, with true and false positives where the outliers are known.

```{r}
summarize_detection <- function(label, res, tail, true_out_idx = NULL) {
  flags <- list("RewML Box-Cox/YJ" = flag_by_tail(as.numeric(res$YJ$Y[, 1]), tail),
                "SHASH-z"          = res$SHASH.z$out_idx,
                "SHASH-i"          = res$SHASH.i$out_idx)
  cat("\n===", label, "===\n")
  for (m in names(flags)) {
    f <- flags[[m]]
    if (is.null(true_out_idx)) {
      cat(m, "flagged:", length(f), "| rows:", paste(f, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    } else {
      cat(m, "flagged:", length(f),
          "| TP:", length(intersect(f, true_out_idx)),
          "| FP:", length(setdiff(f, true_out_idx)),
          "| missed:", paste(setdiff(true_out_idx, f), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
}

for (v in names(topgear_vars))
  summarize_detection(topgear_vars[[v]]$label, topgear_results[[v]], topgear_vars[[v]]$tail)
for (v in names(hbk_vars))
  summarize_detection(paste("HBK", v), hbk_results[[v]], "upper", hbk_vars[[v]]$true_out)
summarize_detection("Wood PC1", res_wood, "upper", true_out_wood)
```

Top Gear: the five lightest flagged vehicles for Weight, and the most expensive vehicles for Price.

```{r}
w_ok <- !is.na(TopGear$Weight)
tg   <- TopGear[w_ok, ]
res  <- topgear_results$Weight
flag <- list("RewML"   = flag_by_tail(as.numeric(res$YJ$Y[, 1]), "both"),
             "SHASH-z" = res$SHASH.z$out_idx,
             "SHASH-i" = res$SHASH.i$out_idx)

imap_dfr(flag, function(idx, m) {
  tibble(method = m, Maker = tg$Maker[idx], Model = tg$Model[idx], Weight = tg$Weight[idx])
}) %>%
  arrange(Weight) %>%
  print(n = 50)

# same vehicles for all three methods?
Reduce(intersect, flag)

TopGear %>% arrange(desc(Price)) %>% dplyr::select(Maker, Model, Price) %>% head(5)
```

HBK: the iForest+ initialization for X1 and X2. For X2 the smallest flagged value is 23, so the outliers below it are not initialized.

```{r}
map_dfr(c("X1", "X2"), function(v) {
  init <- rrobot::outlier_init(hbk[[v]], method = "isoplus", thr_iso = 0.6, tail = "upper")
  tibble(variable     = v,
         flagged_init = paste(which(!init$weight_new), collapse = ","),
         cutoff_upper = init$cutoff_upper)
})
```

Degenerate fits (more than 1% of transformed values beyond |z| = 20).
Top Gear Price is degenerate for SHASH-z; the HBK spikes at 7 are degenerate fits.

```{r}
stopifnot("max_abs_z" %in% names(formals(rrobot::SHASH_out)))   # needs the rrobot degeneracy check

all_fits <- c(
  set_names(topgear_results, paste("TopGear", map_chr(topgear_vars, "label"))),
  set_names(hbk_results, paste("HBK", names(hbk_results))),
  list("Wood PC1" = res_wood)
)
true_outs <- c(set_names(rep(list(NULL), length(topgear_vars)), paste("TopGear", map_chr(topgear_vars, "label"))),
               set_names(map(hbk_vars, "true_out"), paste("HBK", names(hbk_vars))),
               list("Wood PC1" = true_out_wood))

imap_dfr(all_fits, function(res, label) {
  map_dfr(c("SHASH.z", "SHASH.i"), function(m) {
    f   <- res[[m]]
    big <- which(abs(f$x_norm) > 20)
    to  <- true_outs[[label]]
    tibble(
      data        = label,
      method      = sub("SHASH.", "SHASH-", m, fixed = TRUE),
      degenerate  = isTRUE(f$degenerate),
      max_abs_z   = round(f$max_abs_z, 1),
      n_extreme   = f$n_extreme,
      n_flagged   = length(f$out_idx),
      extreme_all_true_out = if (is.null(to) || !length(big)) NA else all(big %in% to)
    )
  })
}) %>%
  print(n = 30, width = Inf)
```
